title: The Evolution of Analytical Electron Microscopy Instrumentation and Techniques During the Career of Jim Bentley
content: Analytical Electron Microscopy (AEM) has evolved significantly since its early days from a sister technique of SEM microanalysis focused on qualitative and quantitative analysis of sub-micron areas of specimens [1] to a broad set of techniques to characterize all aspects of the structure of materials down to and below the nanometer scale [2, 3], and to produce one-, two-, and three-dimensional maps of those characteristics on a practical time scale. The evolution of AEM instrumentation and techniques will be reviewed to determine the state of the art and to serve as a guideline for future developments.
